title: Clipper GPU Encoding Update
summary: The Clipper can finally use your GPU instead of beating the CPU to death.
notes:
YTD Clipper update

- GPU encoding is finally here, so clipping videos should be way faster now.
- NVIDIA and AMD GPUs are supported.
- H.264, HEVC, and AV1 can use the GPU.
- Added a big button to switch between GPU and CPU encoding.
- Unsupported GPUs and codecs automatically use the CPU.
- If GPU encoding fails, the Clipper automatically retries with the CPU.
- Intel GPUs are not supported and will use CPU encoding.
- The title bar now shows which encoder is being used.
- Fast Lossless still skips encoding and copies the original streams.

changes.text: Added NVIDIA NVENC and AMD AMF hardware encoding.
Added GPU support for H.264, HEVC, and AV1.
Added a simple GPU/CPU encoding switch in the Clipper.
Unsupported GPU codecs now automatically use the CPU.
Failed GPU exports automatically retry with CPU encoding.
Intel GPUs are not supported and use CPU encoding.
The title bar now shows the active encoder.
